auth.tooManyAttempts: TOO MANY ATTEMPTS — WAIT A MOMENT

walkieTypie.commitFailed: SEND FAILED — MESSAGE MAY NOT REACH CONTACT

files.openBlocked: POPUP BLOCKED — ALLOW POPUPS TO PREVIEW LOCAL FILE

hints.push: Go to a newer note. If you're already at the newest, a blank page opens — type anything to create a new one.
hints.pull: Go to an older note. If the current blank page has text, it's saved first.
hints.commit: Upload ALL notes in this notebook to the cloud, replacing the cloud copy. Your latest version wins. Files included. Failed file uploads retry next time.
hints.checkout: Re-download the selected notebook from the cloud, replacing your local copy.
hints.switch: Open a different notebook. If it only lives in the cloud, it's downloaded first.
hints.fork: Make a copy of every note in this notebook as a brand new notebook. Original and copy are independent.
hints.dropClean: Wipe every note in this notebook. An empty placeholder remains — the notebook itself survives.
hints.dropDrop: Delete the cloud copy of this notebook. Your local copy stays.
hints.dropDelete: Permanently remove this empty notebook from your device. Cannot be undone.
hints.shelfHandle: Shelf grip. Drag LEFT to open wider, RIGHT to shrink. Double-click to close.
hints.wipeLocal: Clear all locally stored notebooks, messages, channels and cached files. Settings and sign-in survive. Server data untouched. Page reloads. Three-step confirm.
hints.dropAllBranches: Delete ALL your notebooks from the cloud. Sign-in required. Local data untouched. Three-step confirm.
hints.installApp: Install the app to your device for offline access. On iOS use Safari's Share → Add to Home Screen.
hints.initializeWebsiteData: Clear every local surface (notebooks, messages, settings, cache, service worker) and reload. Returns the device to a first-visit state. Sign-in cookie survives. Three-step confirm.
hints.resetConfig: Reset this section's settings to defaults. Three-step confirm.
hints.unbindEmail: Disconnect your email from this account. You can link it again later.
hints.deleteAccount: Permanently erase this account and all server data. Cannot be undone. Sign-in ends.
hints.chipStatus: File status: [LOCAL] only on this device, [SYNCED] on device and cloud, [CLOUD] cloud only (click to download). Click the icon to preview.
hints.branchName: Current notebook or channel name. Read-only here — rename on the list page.

wt.theyPush: View a newer message on your contact's side (read-only).
wt.theyPull: View an older message on your contact's side (read-only).
wt.wePush: Go to a newer message on your side. Your contact sees the preview almost instantly (~20ms). Full send to cloud happens ~2s after you stop typing. On the newest page, a new blank message page opens.
wt.wePull: Go to an older message on your side. Any current text is saved first.
wt.add: Connect with another user by USERNAME. Both sides get a shared pair of message boards.
wt.cut: Disconnect this contact and erase all message history between you two on both sides.
wt.theyBoard: Your contact's side — read only. Live preview via whisper (~20ms); full messages appear ~2s after they stop typing.

bc.pin: Subscribe to this channel — you'll receive announcements from the lecturer (or channel owner) and see their calendar. Subscribed channels appear at the top of your list.
bc.cast: Publish ALL posts in this channel to everyone, replacing its cloud contents. Failed file uploads retry next time.
bc.create: Start a new local channel. Write posts first, then POST to publish.
bc.delete: Permanently destroy this channel and all its posts (local + cloud). Owner only. Cannot be undone.

mods.refresh: Re-scan available extensions and check if they're online.

config.showHints: Show hover hints like this one on buttons. Turn off for a cleaner view once familiar.
config.autoSync: Two-way cloud sync for the current notebook: uploads 2s after idle, downloads remote changes in ~4s. Other notebooks sync when you open them. Requires sign-in.
config.boardSwap: My side on top, contact below. OFF = contact on top (default).
config.notifications: Desktop notifications when a new message arrives and the tab is in the background. Requires browser permission.
config.screensaverTimeout: Seconds of inactivity before screensaver activates. Max = disabled.

llm.button: Send the current note to the AI tutor. Answer appears in the panel below.
llm.temperature: AI creativity. 0 = strict and consistent. 1 = open and creative. 0.3–0.7 recommended for study use.

markdownPreview.button: Render the current note as formatted Markdown below.

misc.installUnavailable: INSTALL UNAVAILABLE — REQUIRES A CHROMIUM-BASED BROWSER. IF YOU HAVE ONE, USE THE APP A BIT FIRST — THE BROWSER NEEDS ENGAGEMENT BEFORE IT OFFERS INSTALL.
